verdict.rationale: WezTerm is a terminal emulator, not a coding agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server, and no probe found one. The `wezterm cli` headless control loop is a developer building block an agent could drive, not an official MCP server, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
